correctness.rationale: Disjoint separable branch divisors imply connected genus-five Klein-four cover. A prime-to-five quotient-Jacobian isogeny splits p-torsion into elliptic, elliptic, and genus-three parts. The reciprocal characteristic-five Hasse–Witt matrix becomes diagonal over F5 with five explicit factors, so stable Cartier rank and kernel dimension are computed exactly. Ten saturated Groebner ideals have two simple F25 points each, with all ten triple ideals equal to the unit ideal. Actual standalone symbolic verifier and independently implemented F25 census both print their success markers. The theorem does not infer geometric completeness from the finite census.

originality.rationale: The main 2024 genus-five disjoint-elliptic Howe construction addresses plane-sextic models and singularities, not characteristic-five Cartier eigenvalues or a complete two-parameter rank stratification. The 2021 generalized Howe source establishes Jacobian decomposition but has no identical five-factor locus. Broader 2025 bielliptic p-rank dimension statements and examples do not imply the absence of ranks below three or the twenty exceptional parameters in this specific reciprocal-quartic family. Targeted literature and research-index queries located no equal or dominating statement; residual unindexed overlap is acknowledged.
residual_risks: An unindexed earlier calculation of p-ranks for the reciprocal-quartic Howe subfamily may exist.
The twenty ordered parameter pairs can correspond to fewer isomorphism classes; no moduli-orbit count is asserted.
Searches and source inspection cannot establish absolute novelty.

value.rationale: This natural genus-five elliptic/elliptic Howe family has sharply restricted p-rank: ranks 0,1,2 cannot occur, while a nontrivial codimension-two minimum locus has exactly twenty geometric points with explicit equations. This is a complete structural arithmetic stratification of a literature-motivated family and identifies constraints absent in ambient bielliptic genus-five moduli. The exact invariant and boundary are mathematically motivated; the contribution is not just a generic coefficient substitution or finite random sample.
